run_doctest_callbacks: run the doctest module to test Boost.Python callback extension functions
test_apply_int_int: test apply_int_int by passing a Python callable and integer argument to the C++ extension
test_apply_void_X_ref: test apply_void_X_ref by passing a Python callable that mutates an X object by reference
test_apply_X_ref_handle: test apply_X_ref_handle by passing a lambda that accesses an X object attribute via handle
test_apply_object_object: test apply_object_object by passing an identity function that returns the same Python object
